title: Red Head Coleus - 1x Mini Plug Plant - Deep Ruby Red Foliage
description:
Bring a vibrant splash of ruby red to your garden with this rich ruby-red Coleus!
KEY FEATURES
• Vibrant, glowing red foliage for season-long colour.
• Versatile, thriving in full sun to partial shade.
• Excellent for containers, borders, and landscape planting.
• Low-maintenance with a vigorous, uniform growth habit.
PLANT DETAILS
Type: Houseplants — Coleus scutellarioides 'Redhead'
Colour: Medium red foliage
Season: Summer to autumn
Growth Habit: Upright spreading bush
GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Full sun to partial shade
Soil: Rich, moist, well-drained soil
Watering: High water use; keep evenly moist, allowing soil to dry slightly between waterings (1-2" per week)
Spacing: 45-60 cm (1.5-2 ft)
Height: 45-90 cm (1.5-3 ft)
Spread: 40-70 cm (1.3-2.3 ft)
Hardiness: H1C (Tender Annual)
CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant out two weeks after the last spring frost when soil has warmed.
• Pinch back tips when planting and regularly to encourage a bushy form.
• Water freely during the growing season, ensuring soil remains moist but not waterlogged.
• Feed with a time-released fertiliser at planting or a regular water-soluble feed.
• Can be brought indoors before the first frost to overwinter as a houseplant.
WHAT'S INCLUDED
1x Mini Plug Plant
